table.method: Exact rational truncated principal part; positive-coefficient tail and all other roots bounded separately.

auxiliary.bernoulli_convention: B1=+1/2, including the global2021 change and page569 substitutions
auxiliary.c3_leading: c3 = 1/(3 sqrt(n)) + O(n^(-9/2)) for m=n^3/alpha, fixed positive alpha; see proof note

printed_approximation.distinction: This certifies evaluation of the printed three-term asymptotic approximation, not its error relative to exact q.
